title: Raw path encoding
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Boolean word $M$, and natural numbers $s,t$, define the raw path encoding by pairing the length-$n$ all-true word with the result of pairing $M$ with the encoding obtained by pairing the binary digit lists of $s$ and $t$.
caveat: The payload does not define the pairing-encoding operation or the convention for the binary digit lists.
